name: A40 vLLM: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B median TTFT, 50 concurrent
unit: ms (median time to first token, 50 concurrent)
methodology: Database Mart hosted-GPU report, page footer dated 10/07/2026. Engine is vLLM built from github.com/vllm-project/vllm with no release tag or commit printed, so the engine version is unpinned. Weights are the Hugging Face checkpoint at the precision the table labels 'Quantization 16' (bf16/fp16 not distinguished); format_id is null because data/quantization/ has no fp16/bf16 record. Single GPU, tensor parallel 1. Input length fixed at 100 tokens, output length fixed at 600 tokens. The 'Output (tokens/s)' column is aggregate generated tokens across the concurrent requests divided by benchmark duration, NOT a per-request decode rate. Median TTFT is the median time to first token under that same concurrency. Third-party measurement by the GPU host; confidence capped because the harness and the vLLM commit are unpublished. Card: NVIDIA A40, Ampere, 48 GB GDDR6, 10,752 CUDA cores. 50 requests, input length 100, output length 600, benchmark duration 26.72 s, total input tokens 5000, total generated tokens 11937. MEDIAN across the concurrent requests, not a single-request TTFT.
